annotations.annotation_text: Street slang for amphetamine crystals or crystalline stimulants, consumed in Night City to sustain hyper-alert wakefulness in the twenty-four-hour sprawl.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 28.

annotations.target_phrase: the glasses were surgically inset, sealing her sockets
annotations.annotation_text: Molly's iconic silver mirrored lenses, surgically bonded flush with the bone of her eye sockets. They contain internal digital readouts, time displays, and low-light amplification, erasing the human gaze.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 28.
Hayles, N. Katherine. How We Became Posthuman. U of Chicago P, 1999.
